Carmen: quick thread 15m: refining messaging for the pricing page experiment. main asks: hero copy variations, CTA wording, and how we frame the FAQ section.
Ishaan: suggestion: hero variant A = "Predictable inference costs for production LLMs". Variant B = "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost". both short.
Rina: CTA options: "Estimate your bill" (actionable), "Get a commitment quote" (premium), "Try quick estimator" (casual). keep testing.
Dex: small UX point: place micro-FAQ just below the estimator results so folks can read clarifications after they see a number. also show a tooltip on "intent score".
AnalyticsBot: Reminder: include event `pricing_calc_result` and property `intent_score_reason` for A/B analysis.
Carmen: I'll stitch these into the variant doc and send to design. Also, will add a short line in FAQ about how reserved capacity discounts compound with committed tokens. Rina, can you draft?
Rina: will do. +1 on tooltip idea. Dex: can you mock tooltip copy?
Dex: tooltip: "Intent score is a composite of tokens, commitment length, and webinar interest. Scores > .7 indicate likely buyers." short and clear.
Carmen: timeline: variants ready for QA Tue; deploy Wed. Any blockers?
Ishaan: none. will finalize H1 by EOD.
Rina: putting draft FAQ row in the shared doc now.
Dex: will prototype tooltip in Figma and share link.
AnalyticsBot: Note: A/B metric: calc_open -> commitment_modal_open conversion; set 95% conf interval check for 7 days post-launch.
Carmen: cool. thanks all. I'll post the variant doc in the channel when ready.
